---
title: Connect Claude
description: Add WriteStack as a custom connector in Claude (web or desktop) and sign in with OAuth. No API key needed.
---

Claude connects with OAuth: you paste the endpoint, sign in to WriteStack, and approve access.

## Steps

1. In Claude, open **Settings → Connectors** and choose **Add custom connector**.
2. Name it `WriteStack` and paste the endpoint:
   ```text
   https://www.writestack.io/api/mcp/mcp
   ```
3. Click **Connect**. Claude opens WriteStack. Sign in and approve access.
4. In a chat, turn on the WriteStack connector from the tools menu and ask, for example: "What's in my WriteStack queue this week?"

A connector added on Claude web also works in Claude Desktop with the same account.

Claude's menus change from time to time. If a step looks different, follow the [step-by-step guide with screenshots](https://blogs.writestack.io/?post=2-guides-4-add-mcp-connector).

## If it doesn't work

| Problem | Fix |
| --- | --- |
| "MCP access is not available on your current plan" | Your plan doesn't include MCP. See [plans and limits](/docs/account/plans-and-limits). |
| Sign-in window closes and nothing connects | Log in to [writestack.io](https://www.writestack.io) in the same browser first, then connect again. |
| Notes were scheduled but didn't post | Expected for Notes scheduled over MCP. Open WriteStack, go to **My Notes → Scheduled notes** and click **Sync N scheduled notes to Substack**. See [Sync](/docs/using/concepts/sync). |
